initial_question: List all customers who have initiated at least one payment transaction and the total amount they have transacted, sorted by the total amount in descending order.
initial_gql: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction) RETURN c.name AS customer_name, SUM(pt.amount) AS total_amount ORDER BY total_amount DESC

initial_question: Identify accounts that have been involved in transactions governed by compliance rules requiring monitoring and return the account details along with the rule descriptions.
initial_gql: MATCH (acc:Account)<-[:FundsFrom|ReceivesTo]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:GovernedBy]->(cr:ComplianceRule {monitoring_required: true}) RETURN DISTINCT acc, cr.description

initial_question: Retrieve the names and risk levels of merchants involved in transactions governed by compliance rules requiring monitoring, along with the count of such transactions per merchant.
initial_gql: MATCH (m:Merchant)<-[:ProcessedFor]-(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:GovernedBy]->(cr:ComplianceRule {monitoring_required: true}) RETURN m.business_name, m.risk_level, COUNT(pt) AS transaction_count

initial_question: List all customers who have initiated transactions using expired payment methods (expiry_date before today), including the transaction IDs and method types used.
initial_gql: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction)-[:AuthorizedBy]->(pm:PaymentMethod) WHERE pm.expiry_date < date() RETURN c.name, pt.transaction_id, pm.method_type

initial_question: List all customers who have initiated at least one payment transaction exceeding 1000 units in amount.
initial_gql: MATCH (c:Customer)-[:Initiates]->(pt:PaymentTransaction) WHERE pt.amount > 1000 RETURN DISTINCT c
